title: Count points on an intersection of quadrics over F5

source.citation: John Bamberg, Anton Betten, Philippe Cara, Jan De Beule, Michel Lavrauw, and Max Neunhoeffer, FinInG: a package for Finite Incidence Geometry, arXiv:1606.05530

translation.notes: The paper's two homogeneous quadrics are independently entered as a projective scheme over F5 and counted with Noether's certified enumerator. The explanatory prose and program are original; no paper source is redistributed.
